_comment: The derivation formulas -- see include/Stats.h. Nothing in the game authors health, stamina or defense directly; they all come out of these curves and the five stats. player is the starting sheet.

feedback._comment: HOW BEING HURT LOOKS. flash/death_flash are how long a struck body stays lit, in seconds; a kill holds longer and stays on screen for it. wound_from is the fraction of health below which he starts to show it -- a body that reddens from the first scratch is always saying the same thing and so says nothing. wound_depth is how far green and blue are pulled out at nothing-left, and wound_red pushes red above full so a wounded man reads as lit rather than dimmed.
